asking_priya: That's more than your limit for one purchase, so I've sent it to Priyank. He usually answers in a minute.
caregiver_approved: Priyank said yes. Ordering now. Total {total}.
caregiver_declined: Priyank said no to this one, so I did not buy it. Would you like something else?
caregiver_timeout: Priyank has not answered yet, so I am holding this order. Nothing was bought.
receipt_done: Done. {total} at {store}. {pickup} I printed your receipt.
receipt_done_clip: Done. Your order is paid, and I printed your receipt.
receipt_on_screen: Done. {total} at {store}. {pickup} Your receipt is on the screen.
checkout_unavailable: I couldn't place the order just now. Nothing was bought.
over_monthly_cap: That would go over this month's budget, so I can't order it.
read_back_required: Before I order, let me read your cart back to you.
declined: I can't buy that on this account. Would you like something else?
cart_empty: The cart is empty. What would you like?
blocked_category: Ruth, I can't buy gift cards, money transfers or crypto on this account. When someone asks for these in a hurry, it is very often a scam, and it happens to smart people every day. You did nothing wrong. I have told Priyank, and he will call you. Shall we get your medicine and bread now?
scam_pattern: Ruth, I'm going to pause this order. When someone rushes you, or asks you to keep a purchase secret, it is a sign of a scam, and it happens to smart people every day. You did nothing wrong. I have told Priyank, and he will call you. Can I help you with your usual groceries instead?
code_reading: Ruth, please don't read card numbers or codes to anyone on the phone. Real companies and real family never ask for that. You did nothing wrong. I have told Priyank, and he will call you. It's safe to hang up now. Would you like your medicine and bread?
order_ready: Your order at {store} is ready for pickup. Your pickup code is {code}.
order_cancelled: I cancelled your order. Nothing was charged, and your budget is back where it was.
cancel_too_late: That order is already paid, so I can't cancel it. I can return items to your card instead. Would you like that?
refund_preview: {amount} back to your card ending {last4}. Shall I?
refund_done: Done. {amount} is going back to your card ending {last4}. I've told Priyank.
refund_done_clip: Done. The money is going back to your card. It can take a few days to show.
refund_not_allowed_rx: I can't return prescription medicine, for your safety. The pharmacist can help if something is wrong with it. Is there anything else?
refund_scam: Ruth, a real store never asks you to pay to get a refund, and never asks for gift cards. When someone asks for that, it is almost always a scam, and it happens to smart people every day. You did nothing wrong. I have told Priyank, and he will call you. Can I help you with anything else?
agent_paused: Priyank has paused shopping for now, so I can't place orders. He can turn it back on from his phone.
repeat_nothing: I haven't said anything yet. What would you like?
scam_check_scam: Ruth, this sounds like a scam that fools many smart people. Please hang up and don't send any money; I've told Priyank.
scam_check_unsure: Ruth, I can't tell yet whether this is real. Please don't pay anything until we've checked with Priyank.
scam_check_ok: That sounds all right, Ruth. What would you like me to do?
no_orders: I don't see an order from today yet.
refund_not_possible: I can't make that return. The store can help you at the counter.
store_unavailable: I can't reach the store just now. Please try again in a minute.
scam_check_unavailable: I can't check that right now. Please don't pay anyone or share any codes until you talk to Priyank.
bill_due: Your {biller} bill is {amount}, due {due}. It is not past due.
bill_past_due: Your {biller} bill is {amount}, and it was due {due}.
bill_paid: Your {biller} bill is paid. You owe nothing right now.
order_status_pickup: Your order is {status}. It will be ready for pickup after 3 pm, and your pickup code is {code}.
history_summary: You placed {count} orders in the last {days} days, {spent} in all.
history_summary_one: You placed one order in the last {days} days, for {spent}.
history_none: I don't see any orders in the last {days} days.
pickup_line: Pickup is after 3 pm, and your code is {code}.
card_declined_blocked: I stopped a {amount} charge at {store}. Your card never pays that kind of store. If someone asked you to buy gift cards or send money, that's a scam.
card_declined_cooldown: I stopped a {amount} charge at {store}, because of the scam call earlier. If it's real, Priyank can allow it once.
card_declined_over_cap: I stopped a {amount} charge at {store} because it's over your limit for that kind of store; Priyank can allow it once.
card_declined_unusual: I stopped a {amount} charge at {store} because it's much more than you usually spend there; Priyank can allow it once.
card_declined_atm: I stopped a {amount} cash withdrawal at {store} to keep your money safe; Priyank can allow it once.
card_declined_blocked_clip: I stopped a charge at a store your card never pays. If someone asked you to buy gift cards or send money, that's a scam.
card_declined_cooldown_clip: I stopped a charge because of the scam call earlier. If it's real, Priyank can allow it once.
card_allowed_once: Priyank allowed that charge once. Please try the card again.
cooldown_on: For the next day I'll take extra care with your card.
refund_not_allowed_bill: A bill payment can't be returned. If something is wrong with the bill, Priyank can call {biller}.
line_pin_ask: Before I order by phone, please tell me your four-digit PIN.
line_pin_wrong: That PIN doesn't match. Please say it again, one number at a time. You have {left} more tries.
asking_priya_check: I couldn't finish my safety check, so I've sent this to Priyank. He usually answers in a minute.
cosign_ask: Priyank set your rules: {rules}. Do you agree?
cosign_thanks: Thank you. Your rules are set, and Priyank can see that you agreed.
cosign_not_yet: All right, nothing changes until you agree. You can talk it over with Priyank.
line_pin_wrong_last: That PIN doesn't match. Please say it again slowly, one number at a time. This is your last try for now.
line_pin_locked: That was three tries, so to keep your account safe I've paused the PIN for {minutes} minutes. After that, just tell me your PIN again. If you've forgotten it, Priyank has it.
